summary.zh-CN: Supabase 官方托管远程 MCP 服务，默认以只读模式（read_only=true）连接：可查看项目与数据表、以只读数据库用户执行查询、查看日志与安全建议、查看边缘函数。由 Teloa 以 OAuth（动态客户端注册 + PKCE）授权，令牌自动刷新，不需要填写访问令牌。
summary.en: Supabase's official hosted remote MCP service, connected in read-only mode (read_only=true) by default: browse projects and tables, run queries as a read-only database user, read logs and advisors, and view Edge Functions. Authorized by Teloa via OAuth (dynamic client registration + PKCE) with automatic token refresh; no access token needs to be entered.

description.zh-CN: 获取项目 API 地址

conditions.zh-CN: 需在 市场 > 连接 页由本人在浏览器中完成 OAuth 授权；服务器部署需在配置文件设置 oauth.publicCallbackUrl
conditions.en: The owner must complete OAuth authorization in a browser from Market > Connections; server deployments must set oauth.publicCallbackUrl in the config file

conditions.zh-CN: 官方文档确认托管服务默认使用动态客户端注册；本机回环回调（127.0.0.1）尚未实测
conditions.en: Official docs confirm the hosted server uses dynamic client registration by default; the loopback callback (127.0.0.1) has not been tested yet

conditions.zh-CN: 授权只申请服务端公开的资源配置里列出的只读 scope（组织、项目、数据库、分析、边缘函数、环境）；服务端是否按 scope 收窄令牌尚未实测，未收窄时令牌仍具全部权限。连接设置另带 read_only=true（官方参数：以只读 Postgres 用户执行查询，写工具不注册）
conditions.en: Authorization requests only the read scopes listed in the server's published resource configuration (organizations, projects, database, analytics, edge functions, environment); whether the server narrows the token by scope is untested, and without narrowing the token still carries full permissions. The connection settings also set read_only=true (official parameter: queries run as a read-only Postgres user and write tools are not registered)

conditions.zh-CN: 建议只连接非生产项目；只读模式下迁移、部署函数等写工具不可用，存储功能组不在默认启用范围
conditions.en: Prefer non-production projects; write tools such as migrations and function deploys are unavailable in read-only mode, and the storage feature group is not enabled by default
